description: Defines a class for scaling images while maintaining aspect ratio within Drupal's GD image toolkit module.

classes.name: Scale
classes.description: A class that performs image scaling operations with aspect ratio preservation in Drupal's GD image toolkit.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Defines the arguments for the scale operation, including width, height, and upscale options.

methods.name: validateArguments
methods.description: Validates and adjusts the input arguments for the scaling operation, ensuring at least one dimension is provided and dimensions are positive integers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the scaling operation if the target dimensions differ from current dimensions and upscaling is permitted.
